verdicts.summary: Lean uses a different formula here. Both windows have named counterparts and the cut step is proved; what the Lean does not have is the paper's single nested triple of sets over one ambient ℰ_γ. Ω_γ^cut: `actualSourceCore` = `actualSlowCore` ×ˢ `sourceCell r L 1`, with `sourceCell r L c = Icc (-r) r ×ˢ Icc ((L/c)/6) (5(L/c)/6)`; ξ is the Plane's first coordinate, so the factor Icc (-r) r is the ξ_g(H) ∈ supp χ_g clause and the factor Icc (L/6) (5L/6) is the v(H) ∈ supp ψ clause — it is exactly where the v cut-off can be nonzero, since that cut-off is `profile ((pulseCoordinates L x).2)` and `profile_zero` kills profile off |·- 1/2| < 1/3 (this is the computation in `nativeGaussian_source_support`). Lifted to the torus it is `labelCarrier`, periodized `nativeUnion`. Ω_γ (the same conditions without the ψ cut): the plane-side counterpart is named, `(ActualPrimary.clockWindow L).core` = Icc (-radius) radius ×ˢ Icc 0 (slotLength …), i.e. the same ξ-range together with the paper's uncut 0 ≤ v ≤ L_s; and `ActualPhaseJetBounds.phaseCell` is a named set conjoining that window with the slow-side carrier, so it is the paper's Ω_γ up to the copy index k and the extra `near` conjunct. The paper's step Ω_γ^cut ⊂ Ω_γ is proved on the plane factors as `sourceCell_subset_clock`, and on the slow factors `actualSlowCore_inside` gives `actualSlowCore ⊆ carrier` where 0 < p.2.2. What actually differs: (i) there is no named ambient ℰ_γ = {(x_*,H) : H ∈ closure R^H_γ} — the ambient role is played by the strip domain, and the containments are stated against it as a hypothesis rather than as a set; (ii) the slow factor of the Lean's cut set is `actualSlowCore`, a tsupport of the slow mask, where the paper prescribes a compact K_γ^*, so the two Lean sets are related by a lemma rather than by sharing a factor; (iii) the shell restriction X_a ≤ X ≤ X_b is not a clause of any of these sets but a condition of the strip domain, `nativeStrip_mem`, and there as the open Ioo (leftRadius W) (rightRadius W) rather than the paper's closed interval. Low: both windows and the inclusion between them are stated, and the shell restriction is imposed on every field through the strip, so the surrounding results are proved; what is not available as written is the paper's one-ambient-set packaging.
